text.text_excerpt: This is the cutest store ever. The owner is such a nice lady. She held a conversation in a way that was not intrusive in any way, but that gave you that true New Orleanian feel. The sno ball was good as well. I'll take this place over Plum Street Sno balls any day, even though this is slightly more out of my way.

This place is the cutest ever. The woman who owns this stand is so sweet and amazingly nice. Go there enough and she'll know you by name. Plus, she give you extra juice in your snowball if there's not enough. The snowballs are really cheap too. $1.50 for a small which is enough for a normal person to have enough. Plus, Queen of the Ball sells ice-cream and nachos as most stands do. But this is a really great stand to frequent while you're uptown. They have snowballs all year-round also. It's great. And the atmosphere is really nice. It is the cutest shop.

When deciding where to go for sno-balls, my boyfriend wanted to take me to this "cute place" that he knew I would love. Upon entering Queen of the Ball, I had to give him extra points! Not only is this place adorable -- hot pink, polka dots, the pun!- but it also offers a great selection of sno-ball flavors. The owner lady helping us was so sweet and even though we were in this modern type spot, you still get the independent and small sno-ball shack feel because of the owner-customer interaction.
